What We Clean
Professional Services
Every surface gets the right method — soft wash for siding and roofs, high pressure for concrete and stone. That green film on a South Jersey wall is algae, not dirt — living on the salt air and damp shade.
🏠
House Washing
Soft wash lifts the green off vinyl, cedar shake, stucco and brick — including the shaded north wall that always goes first. Low pressure throughout: the cleaning solution does the work, not force.
Soft Wash
See what is involved →
🏚️
Roof Washing
Low-pressure soft wash clears black streaks, moss and lichen from shingle, metal and cedar shake roofs. Damp shore air feeds the algae behind those streaks, and pressure would cost you shingles.
Soft Wash Only
See what is involved →
🛣️
Driveway & Pavers
Cement, brick and paver drives, walks and patios. Salt scale, moss and years of ground-in grime come up. Pavers are cleaned with minimal pressure, to preserve the polymeric sand that holds them in place.
Pressure Wash
See what is involved →
🪵
Deck & Patio
Decks, porches and outdoor shower floors, composite or wood. Sand and salt grind grey into the boards — we bring the color back without splintering them.
Soft + Pressure
See what is involved →
🔒
Fencing
Vinyl, wood and wrought iron, one side or both. Fences under trees and on shaded runs green up fastest, so they are worth doing yearly.
All Materials
See what is involved →
🍂
Gutter Cleaning
Clearing the inside so water reaches the downspout, and brightening the outside where black tiger striping has set into the face. Two different jobs, and both worth doing.
Clear & Brighten
See what is involved →
🪟
Window Cleaning
Glass, frames and screens. Salt film and hard-water spotting need more than water and a squeegee, and clean glass changes how a house looks more than people expect.
Inside & Out
See what is involved →
✨
Add-On Services
Outdoor furniture, awnings and trash cans, added to any job. Bundling means one visit instead of two, and the bigger the job the better the rate.
Bundle & Save
See what is involved →

Why Choose Us
New Name, Twenty Years of Experience
Osprey Power Wash is new to South Jersey. The person doing the work is not — twenty years of pressure washing behind him, including time on Jersey shore properties. One principle, unchanged: professional results with zero hassle.
📋

Self-Quote in Seconds

Measure your own house off the satellite view and see the price on screen. No waiting on a callback, no sales visit.

📅

Book Your Own Appointment

Pick a date and time that works for you. We'll confirm and be there. No phone tag required.

📷

You Do Not Have To Be Home

Second homes sit empty most of the year and plenty of others sit empty midweek. All we need is access and a working outside water source — then before and after photos come back to you when the job is done.

🌊

Right Method for Every Surface

Soft wash for roofs, siding and decks. High pressure for concrete and pavers. Nothing gets cleaned harder than it can take.

🛡️

Estimate Transparency

If we spot anything that changes your quote, we contact you first — no surprises on billing day. NJ sales tax is shown as its own line, never buried in the price.

Instant Pricing

Where We Work
Our Service Area

We cover South Jersey — the barrier islands, the bay and mainland towns behind them, and inland across Atlantic, Cape May, Cumberland and Gloucester counties. Home base is Corbin City, so the Cape May County shore is a short run, and the mainland is an easy one. Not sure whether you are in? Call and ask.
